question: Burn, EXCEPT
question_ar: جميع الجمل المتعلقة بالحرق صحيحة باستثناء؟ (سؤال مكرر، راجع السؤال رقم 526)

options.text: Burn area's can be calculated by the rule of nines
Fluid resuscitation is calculated based on the burn area
IV fluid resuscitation is necessary for a child with 10% partial thickness burn
Prophylactic might be indicated in inhalation burn
Full-thickness burns extend into deep reticular dermis, yellow-white appearance, fairly dry texture, painful, needs 3-8 weeks for healing

correct_text: Full-thickness burns extend into deep reticular dermis, yellow-white appearance, fairly dry texture, painful, needs 3-8 weeks for healing
